capabilities: Apply formatting styles (bold, italic, highlight, code, strikethrough, comment) to selected text
Combine multiple formatting styles on one selection
Remove formatting from a selected block
Format the word under the cursor in NORMAL mode
Bind formatting commands to leader-key combos in a .vimrc file
extras: README is partly a teaser with a 'Planned Features' list (non-vim selection support, clear-format command) and one stray Russian line; full vimrc examples are provided.
intentEvidence: it enhances the basic text formatting functionality
motivation: The author says existing plugins do similar things but none work properly in Vim VISUAL mode, so they built one that does.
problem: Obsidian's Vim mode lacks reliable commands for applying Markdown formatting to text selected in VISUAL and VISUAL LINE modes.

relations.evidence: install this plugin: - Vimrc Support Implements .vimrc behavior

summary: Vim-mode formatting plugin that applies bold, italic, highlight, code, strikethrough and comment styles to selected text via configurable commands.
